claims.evidence: GOSH: transfusion may involve red blood cells, plasma, platelets; NHS: helps if a lot of blood lost or condition affecting blood or bone marrow.
claims.newSentence: A blood transfusion gives red blood cells, plasma or platelets from a donor to someone who has lost blood or has a condition affecting their blood.

claims.evidence: Search summary of NHS page: NHS describes transfusion as generally very safe; complications possible. Attributed to NHS, with complications noted.
claims.newSentence: The NHS describes it as generally safe, though complications can rarely occur.
